evidence: Each file's suite, the full database suites and the synthetic migration rehearsal (npm run check:db, with Release A's live images' verifiers) on throwaway clusters with fictional data only, as posted on hid-system#258 and each PR with the sha256 of each file. The Release B integration (staging plus every lane, as merge commits) applies on a copy of Release A by a non-superuser migrator in one transaction (as the runner's dry run does), file by file, and with ID-7 before ORD-4, so either order applies; every database suite then passes except schema and records-processing-draft, which fail the same way on every lane (a fixture gap under a non-superuser owner, #310). Every file but 0146 takes its locks first, NOWAIT, with busy refusals that start with its own number (the runner's dry-run retry, #306); 0146 replaces one function and takes no table lock. Each file pins by md5 every function it calls, mirrors or replaces. 0138 (ID-6): a NIN verified later with QoreID at this facility's desk and linked to this facility's own patient (evidence row, verified nin identifier, patient row_version + 1, audit row with no NIN); it keeps 0057's legacy NIN crosswalk as the patient's own check does (409 NIN_LINK_TRY_LATER while the legacy inventory is not complete; another NIN for a migrated patient refused; a NIN the crosswalk gives another patient answered on_another_record only after the match). 0139 (SX-4): a facility administrator, and support at governed facilities with a licence check, add or remove one role for a staff member; a remove revokes the own-facility and break-glass grants no remaining role allows; 0131's open and 0123's break-glass are replaced as signed plus only the lines marked 0139 (D6): the 24-hour refusal needs the patient's own revocation, and both take FOR SHARE on the caller's membership first, so no grant slips past a remove (0139 refuses to apply unless both openers' owners may take that lock). 0140 (SX-8): the patient a staff sign-in had open is kept across a reload for at most 8 hours, at one facility, granting nothing (behind STAFF_OPEN_PATIENT_ENABLED, off by default). 0141 (EHR-C6): the unfinished consultation form saved on the server for its author only, deleted 7 days after the last save, and kept while a legal hold names the patient or the author (Q138 A); never part of the record. 0142 (EHR-C8b): one vitals reading marked entered in error, for good. 0143 (MY-1): one list of the lab requests and prescriptions this member ordered at this facility. 0144 (ORD-4): the pharmacist accepts a prescription before dispensing. 0145 (ID-7): an unknown patient record (no login, no NIN, found only at the facility that made it), its identification, review and cancellation. 0146 (#322): completing a document upload works again: ehr.reject_document_object_rebinding() (0112) reads the owner of ocr.jobs by name, so ehr-api's UPDATE of ehr.documents no longer fails 42501 for want of USAGE on schema ocr; the same rule, attributes, owner and ACL, and no grant. Old images on this schema: the rehearsal runs Release A's live images' twelve runtime verifiers after each of 0138-0146 (the runner can stop between any two files), and each passes at every point; Release A's desk-registration verifier counts its registration audit rows with the replay's own row set aside, because 0145 (ID-7) audits a desk registration's replay (the replay's answer is unchanged). 0139's openers answer as signed except the two D6 changes.
